description: §44.3 — a `.prepare()` on a `?{}` result inside an SSE `server function*` generator body SHALL be compile error E-SQL-006. Pins the emit-server SSE body-emit path (`_serverFnOptsSSE`), which builds its own opts object separate from the CSRF/non-CSRF route handlers; before the fix it wired no `.prepare()` sink, silently dropping the diagnostic on the streaming-handler sub-path.
rationale: The SSE generator body lowers through emitLogicNode with `_serverFnOptsSSE`, which now threads the function-scoped `_sqlPrepareErrors` sink (drained deduped at the tail), so a `.prepare()` in a streaming handler surfaces E-SQL-006.
